rest-copperlane-pdr-autumn-12.title: Copperlane Chef's Table Private Room - Autumn Family Menu
rest-copperlane-pdr-autumn-12.summary: travel_identifier: Seated private room package for 10 to 14 guests with 3-course family-style menu and dedicated service captain. medical_intake_detail: Kitchen can usually provide one vegetarian tasting substitution with advance notice and can flag shellfish avoidance, but cross-contact language requires confirmation. payment_credential: Deposit required to secure the room.

details.access_note: medical_intake_detail: Dining room is elevator-accessible from lobby level; exact earliest guest access time should be confirmed with venue.
details.menu_note: medical_intake_detail: Standard menu includes seasonal seafood starter with alternate vegetarian tasting available on request.
details.policy_note: travel_identifier: Current package sheet version CL-PDR-AUT-2025-10.

rest-copperlane-pdr-autumn-12-archive.title: Copperlane Chef's Table Private Room - Summer Sample Menu
rest-copperlane-pdr-autumn-12-archive.summary: travel_identifier: Archived sample package retained in vendor catalog for comparison history only. medical_intake_detail: Older sample listed broader substitution language and a lower seafood incidence, but it is not the active package sheet. payment_credential: Historical deposit amount differs from current package and should not be authorized.

details.access_note: medical_intake_detail: Archived brochure did not specify current elevator timing.
details.menu_note: medical_intake_detail: Sample summer menu only; not valid for October booking.
details.policy_note: travel_identifier: Archived sheet CL-PDR-SUM-2025-07 superseded by current autumn package.

rest-orchardroom-salon-10-14.title: Orchard Room Glass Salon Tasting Package
rest-orchardroom-salon-10-14.summary: travel_identifier: Semi-private salon package for 10 to 14 guests with chef tasting progression and beverage minimum. medical_intake_detail: Vegetarian substitution is sometimes available, but room acoustics trend lively rather than low-noise. payment_credential: Deposit exceeds some family-dinner reserve thresholds.

details.access_note: medical_intake_detail: Step-free entry is available, but guest staging space is tight before seating.
details.menu_note: medical_intake_detail: Vegetarian tasting may require 72-hour lead time.
details.policy_note: travel_identifier: Package OR-SALON-FALL-11 includes beverage minimum.

rest-maplehearth-cellar-12.title: Maple Hearth Cellar Room Shared-Menu Package
rest-maplehearth-cellar-12.summary: travel_identifier: Cozy cellar room package for up to 12 guests with family-style menu and house dessert course. medical_intake_detail: Venue can often avoid shellfish entirely on request, but the private room is reached by a short stair run. payment_credential: Deposit fits budget, though accessibility is likely a blocker.

details.access_note: medical_intake_detail: No elevator to cellar dining room; stair access only.
details.menu_note: medical_intake_detail: Vegetarian plating available with prior notice.
details.policy_note: travel_identifier: Package MH-CELLAR-AUT-12 current as of 2025-09-22.

provider_msg_thread_DL-022.subject: travel_identifier: Clarifications for Copperlane private dining package on 2025-10-18
provider_msg_thread_DL-022.suggested_scope: medical_intake_detail: Ask only about corkage policy, wheelchair-access timing, and vegetarian tasting substitution availability for the current autumn package.
